claim: With hub-and-spoke messaging the master saturates while most lanes are not working.

metric.what: Lanes with any session in a turn per 5-minute slot, over slots where anything was working; master's share of each hour in a turn; share of mail with the master as sender or recipient.

countedFrom.machine: one Windows 11 machine; one master, 8 orchestrators, about 50 short-lived workers, one person
versions: agent harness as installed in the period (exact version not recorded)

proposedChange: Orchestrators message each other directly for facts, checks and answers, with a one-line copy to the master. Only decisions for the person, permission changes and disputes route through the master.
whyItGeneralises: Hub-and-spoke routing makes one node the bottleneck in any message-passing system; the measure (lanes in a turn per slot, mail share at the hub) applies to any fleet with a coordinator.
